Hi. It raged the rain earlier in March so much but it stopped and today, my wife saw that some beautiful blueborage has sprung along a corner where a bit more rain must collect to nourishment this wild plant which must come in every April.

She snapped it to let the beauty inspire you and wanted to send them on to us as they will with luck, blossom more every next month for the following three.

Do drop and visit when possible or give a shout and maybe meet a beer on your next outing out and see to chat some time when both of are back. Kind
